TN Minister Promises Probe into Alleged Harassment of Woman Collector

A woman Collector in Tamil Nadu has alleged harassment, prompting a promise of investigation from a state minister. Separately, reports suggest actor Trisha Krishnan is being considered for a political entry through the Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam (TVK) party, with some leaders advocating for her candidacy from the Tiruchirappalli East Assembly constituency. The TVK party has also summoned all its MLAs to Chennai for a November 11 meeting chaired by CM Joseph Vijay, amidst a row concerning the Deputy Speaker. Additionally, the BJP has accused the TVK of a 'Rs. 22 Crore fraud', stating that CM Vijay must respond to the allegations.
